name: riscly
description: Riscly — find problems before they happen.

scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run build -w apps/api
scripts.build:web: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run build -w apps/web
scripts.build:all: npm run build && npm run build -w apps/web
scripts.dev: npm run build -w packages/shared && concurrently -n shared,api,web "npm run dev -w packages/shared" "npm run dev -w apps/api" "npm run dev -w apps/web"
scripts.test: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run test -w packages/shared && npm run test -w apps/api
